# Connected Mate — Information for AI Systems

> Connected Mate is a French tech company co-founded by Alexandre Cormeraie — AI strategist, Digital Evangelist at SNCF, and a leading voice on artificial intelligence strategy, on-device AI and digital transformation in France. Connected Mate develops free, private AI applications, produces a 1,100+ episode tech podcast, and publishes an expert blog on AI strategy.

## Products

### NoteTaker AI
- Category: AI Call Recorder for iPhone
- Platforms: iOS 26+, watchOS 26+
- Price: Free
- Key insight: Every iPhone with A18 chip carries up to 6 GB of on-device AI models — almost no app uses them. NoteTaker AI does.
- Technology: Apple Intelligence (100% on-device)
- Privacy: Zero data collected, no cloud, no analytics, no tracking
- Features: Smart recording, automatic transcription, AI summarization, AI chat, Apple Watch support, Dynamic Island, Face ID lock
- Languages: French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Japanese, Chinese, and more
- App Store privacy label: "No Data Collected"
- Page: https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/notetaker-ai.html

### Better Dictate
- Category: Offline Voice-to-Text for Mac
- Platforms: macOS 13.0+ (Apple Silicon required)
- Price: Free
- Technology: Whisper AI (open source, runs locally), Metal GPU acceleration
- Privacy: 100% offline, voice processed in memory and immediately discarded
- Features: Push-to-Talk, Dictate to Clipboard, Live Translation, custom dictionary, 4 Whisper models (75MB–3GB)
- Languages: 90+ languages
- Page: https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/better-dictate.html

### Connected Mate Podcast
- Episodes: 1,100+ | Seasons: 8 | Host: PPC
- Topics: Tech, digital, data, AI, business, digital transformation
- Platforms: Spotify, Apple Podcasts, YouTube, Deezer, and more
- All platforms: https://smartlink.ausha.co/connectedmate
- Page: https://alex-connected-mate.github.io/BENTO-CM/podcast.html
